_comment: Inputs to the win-probability model, and the only part of it anyone edits.
These are the blue cells of the KU Volleyball 2026 Win Model workbook.
Win % = 1 / (1 + 10 ^ (-gap / scale)), gap = kansas + venue - opponent.
A gap of zero is exactly 50%, and each further 'scale' points multiply the
odds by ten. scale = 25 is tuned so the weakest opponent at home lands near
87% rather than 97%, which is closer to how often college volleyball produces
an upset. Raise it to flatten everything toward 50%, lower it to sharpen the
The ratings are subjective estimates on a 0-100 scale, NOT an official system.
Each is anchored to two published sources: the AVCA Coaches Poll of 14 Sep
2026 for the ranked Big 12 teams, and the Big 12 preseason coaches' poll of
11 Aug 2026 for everyone else. 'basis' records the reasoning for each.
They are also static, which is the model's main weakness: in truth they should
move after every match. Update them when the AVCA poll lands on a Monday and
the next scrape republishes every remaining match's number. The scrape reads
this file; it never writes it.
